name: AUCorePatientMinimal
title: AU Core Patient (minimal, hand-authored reproduction — see BUILD_LOG/fhir-gateway.md)
publisher: ReferralPlatform — NOT the official HL7 Australia AU Core IG
description: Minimal, hand-authored reproduction of the key AU Core Patient profile cardinality constraints (identifier, name, birthDate), used to prove genuine HAPI FHIR profile-based validation in this build under the same canonical URL the real AU Core Patient profile uses. This is NOT the official published AU Core Patient profile (au.core.r4 npm package) — that package is distributed via the FHIR package registry, which was not reachable from this build's sandbox network policy. A real AU Core Patient profile additionally slices Patient.identifier to require an IHI-system slice, constrains Patient.gender to the AU value set, and carries formal must-support/binding rules this minimal reproduction does not. Replace this file with the real downloaded package before relying on it for an actual AU Core conformance claim; see BUILD_LOG/fhir-gateway.md, 'Known gaps'.

element.definition: At least one identifier. A real AU Core-conformant profile slices this to require a mandatory IHI slice (system http://ns.electronichealth.net.au/id/hi/ihi/1.0) — this minimal profile checks cardinality only, not the slice.
